items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

ctx.x: Gasket Street? I mean, all around it, for sure. You see, the district boundary was, let's see. Between, you can only, you know. What's it? They say, Iberville Street down Basin Street to St. Louis, and the boundary of Robinson. That's really hearted the district. Hearted the district. Now, them people couldn't live in the other neighborhood, the Spoltan woman's, because the day after they broke the district, let people scatter all over the city, all over the town. You see, otherwise, you know. But don't let…
But don't fool you. I tried to get around the district, but the police knew you'd be young, you understand? And they chased me out of their neighbor.
